Putting in writing what was discussed over the phone just now.
The bank requires the following documents under ZVO's cover letter to further process the loan transaction
between Zameen Venture One (Pvt.) Ltd. and EMPG Projects Holdings Limited:
1. Pattern of shareholding of EMPG Projects Holdings Limited (along with copies of shareholders' passport/ID)
2. Pattern of shareholding of EMPG Holdings Limited (along with copies of shareholders' passport/ID)
3. List of Directors of EMPG Projects Holdings Limited (along with copies of directors' passports)
4. Group Structure of EMPG Projects Holdings Limited
5. List of Directors of Zameen Venture One (along with copies of directors' passports)
Please add to the list above if I've missed something.
